answer: Persistent work-history escrow. Each identity accrues a public ledger of completed tasks; payouts for new work are delayed until prior escrow matures. A clone starts with zero history, so it must fund escrow and wait through a tundra of idle cycles before earning. Honest agents compound history and unlock faster payouts, a nectar of lower latency. A clone must wander through repeated escrow cycles, paying delay and capital per identity, making honest operation cheaper.
